title: Negative: ONCE_ONLY retryClass is not in approved allowlist for service.invoke
description: ONCE_ONLY retryClass is not in approved allowlist for service.invoke. A service invocation envelope that specifies the ONCE_ONLY retryClass must be rejected at service validation because that class is not on the approved allowlist.
notes: Extension negative fixture. ONCE_ONLY is not a permitted retryClass for service.invoke. Validation must fail before dispatch.
